description: A Set/Reset flip flop, latching its output high on a gate at S and low on a gate at R

inputs.text: A gate over 2V here latches the Q output to 10V and the NOT Q output to 0V, as long as the flip flop is enabled
A gate over 2V here returns the Q output to 0V and the NOT Q output to 10V, as long as the flip flop is enabled. With S high at the same time, both outputs go to 10V
With nothing patched here, the flip flop answers its S and R inputs at all times; with a cable patched, a gate over 2V must be present here for S and R to have any effect

outputs.text: 10V after a gate at S and 0V after a gate at R, holding that level until the next one arrives; the level is saved with the patch
0V after a gate at S and 10V after a gate at R, holding that level until the next one arrives; with S and R high together this goes to 10V alongside Q

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
